extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/agents seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; patent practitioners and respondents to OED proceedings
extracted.subtask_description: Evaluative procedure and requirements for a petition to reinstate an individual to practice before the USPTO (Office of Enrollment and Discipline), including submission of a petition and an affidavit under 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 and review by the Director of OED.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitioner must file an Affidavit pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58 in support of the Petition for Reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision expressly notes that an affidavit was filed 'pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.58' and treats such an affidavit as part of the required supporting materials for a petition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of a Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: A formal Petition for Reinstatement must be submitted and is docketed/dated upon receipt (here: received on October 24, 2022).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office considers the Petition as the initiating document; the receipt date is recorded and is part of the record reviewed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review of petition, supporting affidavit, and all record information material to eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director considers the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and 'all information in the record material to [the petitioner's] eligibility for reinstatement' when deciding whether reinstatement is appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The standard of review is expressly described as a careful review of the petition, affidavit, and any other material information in the record bearing on eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's discretionary determination of appropriateness
rubrics_metrics.description: Reinstatement is granted if the Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline determines reinstatement is appropriate based on the review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The decision-maker is the Director (or Deputy General Counsel for Enrollment and Discipline acting in that role); the Director has authority to grant or deny the petition after review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Issuance of formal written decision and notice to petitioner
rubrics_metrics.description: A written decision is issued (signed and dated) granting or denying reinstatement and a copy is provided to the petitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The document demonstrates required formality (signature block, title, date) and indicates that a copy is sent to the petitioner (here: 'Copy to: Mr. Edwin Wold').
